headline: US Court Ruling Imperils Sentinel Midstream Deepwater Oil Export Terminal
summary: A US court ruling has thrown Sentinel Midstream's license for a proposed offshore deepwater crude export project into legal jeopardy, threatening development plans.
why: Deepwater export ports along the US Gulf Coast are designed to handle Very Large Crude Carriers (VLCCs), vital for growing American crude exports.

impacts.name: US Oil Infrastructure
impacts.why: Legal setbacks delay new deepwater crude export capacity on the Texas Gulf Coast.
